Audience: first-time Arizona drivers and permit holders preparing for the written test in English, who must park, change lanes and turn correctly from their first drive.
Why it matters to a first-timer: each painted curb color and each white or yellow line pattern sets a stopping or lane-change rule [A01], and the manual gives an exact lane position for every kind of turn, plus the only left turn allowed on red [A02].
Level: practical recall of three curb colors, several look-alike line rules and the starting and ending lane for each turn type.
Prerequisites: the pavement-marking pages that precede this section.
